actions.tooltip: Execute ia: the runtime runs the described effect and produces value a. Real I/O happens here.
Apply f(a): build the next IO action description from a. No effect yet — only the description is created.
Execute IO b: the runtime runs the second described effect. Effects of ia happened BEFORE this.

objects.tooltip: IO a — a description (recipe) of a side-effectful computation. Nothing has run yet.
(a ⟶ IO b) — given result a, constructs the next IO action description
b — the final result. The sequencing of exec_a before exec_b is the entire bind contract.
